page.title: Squads
page.empty_no_squads: No squads yet. Create one to get started.

archive_dialog.title: Archive this squad?
archive_dialog.description: "{{name}}" will be archived. Issues currently assigned to this squad will be transferred to its leader. This can't be undone — create a new squad if you need the routing back.

add_member_dialog.title: Add Member
add_member_dialog.description: Add a workspace member or agent to this squad.

description_dialog.title: Edit description
description_dialog.responsibility_placeholder: What is this squad responsible for?

discard_changes_dialog.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard_changes_dialog.description: You have unsaved changes on this tab. Switching tabs will discard them.

instructions_tab.description: Squad instructions are injected into the leader agent's prompt whenever it works on an issue assigned to this squad. Use them to give the leader squad-wide guidance, working agreements, or context the leader should follow on every task.
instructions_tab.placeholder: e.g. Always start by writing a failing test. Prefer small, atomic commits.

catalog.title: Squad templates
catalog.description: Choose a workflow and apply it to a new or existing project.

summaries.feature_delivery: Take a feature from requirements through implementation and review.
summaries.bug_fix: Reproduce a bug, find its cause, and verify the fix with regression tests.
summaries.review_gate: Review a finished change for correctness, security, and test coverage.
summaries.discovery: Clarify a request and assess feasibility before committing to implementation.
summaries.docs: Keep release notes, API docs, and runbooks aligned with shipped code.
summaries.maintenance: Upgrade dependencies and resolve security advisories or flaky tests.
summaries.release: Verify a release and prepare its notes and rollback before human approval.
summaries.incident: Restore service, verify recovery, then investigate the root cause.

use_for_project.title: Use {{name}} for a project
use_for_project.description: Set the default squad for future issues. Existing issues and customizations stay as they are.
use_for_project.no_projects: Create a project to use this squad.
use_for_project.resources_error: Could not load the project's resources.
use_for_project.runtime_hint: Choose a runtime for this project, or save the squad choice and connect one later.
use_for_project.agents_error: Could not check the workspace assistant runtime.
use_for_project.runtime_unavailable: This runtime is no longer available. Choose another or connect later.
use_for_project.failed: Could not update the project's squad. Try again.
